### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. retinitis pigmentosa 39  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.793)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:12601)

**Proposed mechanism:** USH2A (HGNC:12601) —DISRUPTS→ Usher syndrome-related ciliogenesis and photoreceptor function (GO:0098940); Usher syndrome-related ciliogenesis and photoreceptor function (GO:0098940) —LEADS_TO→ Retinal degeneration (HP:0000502); Usher syndrome-related ciliogenesis and photoreceptor function (GO:0098940) —LEADS_TO→ Bilateral retinitis pigmentosa (HP:0000527). Loss-of-function mutations in USH2A disrupt ciliogenesis and photoreceptor function, leading to retinal degeneration in Bardet-Biedl syndrome 1 and bilateral retinitis pigmentosa in retinitis pigmentosa 39.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in USH2A that lead to gain-of-function or dominant-negative effects, or finding that the two diseases are caused by distinct genes with no functional overlap. _(variant: rs758701966)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of USH2A in these conditions could lead to therapeutic strategies targeting ciliogenesis or photoreceptor integrity for both Bardet-Biedl syndrome 1 and retinitis pigmentosa 39.

#### 2. Usher syndrome  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.783)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:12601)

**Proposed mechanism:** USH2A (HGNC:12601) —DISRUPTS→ Usher syndrome pathway (photoreceptor structure and function) (GO:0007430); Usher syndrome pathway (photoreceptor structure and function) (GO:0007430) —LEADS_TO→ Retinal degeneration (HP:0000508); Usher syndrome pathway (photoreceptor structure and function) (GO:0007430) —LEADS_TO→ Hearing impairment (HP:0000365). Loss-of-function mutations in USH2A disrupt the Usher syndrome pathway, which is critical for photoreceptor structure and function, leading to retinal degeneration and hearing impairment.

**How to falsify it:** Discovery of a pathogenic gain-of-function variant in USH2A causing either disease, or identification of distinct pathogenic variants in USH2A that affect separate cellular processes leading to divergent phenotypes. _(variant: rs144214586)_

**Why it matters:** Targeting the Usher syndrome pathway downstream of USH2A could offer therapeutic strategies for both retinal degeneration and hearing loss seen in these conditions.
